facts.fact: Leah 说直到不久之前，去过月球的人比下潜超过六千米的人还多。
facts.anchor: more people had been to the moon than had dived beyond depths of six thousand metres

facts.fact: 月球上的脚印几乎可以无限期留存；海不一样，海会把自己的痕迹盖掉。
facts.anchor: The ocean is different, the ocean covers its tracks

facts.fact: 她把下潜说成一次奇特的投降；沉下去仍然只是沉下去，溺水只需要张嘴。
facts.anchor: It’s a curious act of surrender, when you think about it, the act of going under

facts.fact: Miri 从前把她沉默时的走神叫作「沉下去的念头」，用平手拍她后脑勺。
facts.anchor: Miri used to call these my sunken thoughts

facts.fact: 她会抓住 Miri 的手掌按住不放，再把另一只手贴到自己太阳穴，像把「保持头颅完整」交出去。
facts.anchor: I would often catch her palm and keep it there

facts.fact: 失联前二十分钟，Jelka 说她闻到肉味，Leah 也闻到了；Matteo 让她捏住鼻子。
facts.anchor: Jelka told me she thought she smelled meat

facts.fact: 通讯不像信号衰减，更像是被关掉；十分钟后整艘船的系统离线。
facts.anchor: the comms hadn’t faded like a wavering signal so much as been switched off
